logicalCoherence.rationale: The causal distinction between atheism and closed political dogma is coherent and directly defeats the proposed diagnosis, with one broad generalization remaining.

evidenceWarrant.rationale: The comparative historical diagnosis is reasoned but not documented within the excerpt and does not test mixed or rival causal explanations.

relevanceWithinTier.rationale: It strongly supports the central open-inquiry bridge by contrasting closed dogma with revisable rational inquiry as a corrective.

responsivenessWithinClass.rationale: This partial answer contacts a decisive creator component but leaves the scripture-authorship and dogmatic-harm components unanswered.

relevanceWithinTier.rationale: It directly supplies purported grounds for an intentional creator, placing it high within the central creator-and-scripture tier.

additionalComponents.text: Whether atheism was the operative cause of totalitarian atrocities.

responsivenessWithinClass.rationale: It is relevant contrary material on moral grounding but remains a nonanswer to the decisive earlier open-inquiry and causal components.

precisionFindings.rationale: The divine-command contrast is clear, but the claim that discussion alone is the secular basis narrows the opposing account without qualification.

relevanceWithinTier.rationale: It directly supports the indispensable central bridge concerning divine authority and the binding durability of core prohibitions.

additionalComponents.text: Whether human uniqueness or existence supplies evidence for an intentional creator.

responsivenessWithinClass.rationale: This is relevant contrary material about dogmatic effects but a nonanswer to the decisive components of the available earlier targets.
